title: Canada to host Dominican Republic foreign minister
excerpt: The visit on October 19, 2026, marks the first time a Dominican foreign minister has visited Canada in over 20 years.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced on October 18, 2026, that Minister of Foreign Affairs Anita Anand will host Víctor Bisonó, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Dominican Republic, in Canada on October 19, 2026.

During the visit, the ministers plan to discuss economic cooperation, including trade, investment, supply chains, and collaboration on critical minerals and responsible mining. They will also exchange views on regional security challenges, including the ongoing crisis in Haiti.

Canada and the Dominican Republic established diplomatic relations in 1954. The Dominican Republic is one of Canada’s largest bilateral trade and investment partners in the Caribbean and is the most popular destination in the Caribbean for Canadian travellers.

The ministers are scheduled to meet on October 19, 2026.
